description: This file defines an interface class 'IEventHandler' with virtual methods for handling container events such as started, stopped, failed, and state change, using JSON data. It acts as a contract for event handling in the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class declaring event callback methods related to container lifecycle events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container changes state, with event data provided as a JSON object.
